verdict.rationale: The only calendar-feed evidence describes importing external iCal feeds (e.g., personal holidays/PTO) INTO incident.io's schedules, not exporting on-call shift schedules OUT to an engineer's personal calendar via a subscribable feed — the direction the story asks for. No documentation or probe evidence shows an outbound iCal/webcal feed URL for on-call shifts that engineers can subscribe to in their own calendar apps.
